stem:
Nitya explores the diagram of rectangle $PQRS$. She wants to study its diagonals.

Which claim correctly says which corners to join and what to compare?

options.text: Join opposite corners $P$ to $R$ and $Q$ to $S$, then compare those diagonal lengths and the angles they form.
Join adjacent corners $P$ to $Q$ only, because a diagonal is any side of the rectangle.
Join $P$ to $S$ and call that the only diagonal, reversing which corners count as opposite.
Compare only the labels $P$ and $R$ printed on the page as if they were the diagonals.

teacher.key_rationale: Diagonals join opposite corners PR and QS. Adjacent sides are not diagonals; labels alone are not the comparison.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source grid quadrilateral as rectangle PQRS with both dashed diagonals PR and QS.
